render_object_constructor: render an object in constructor format like Foo(bar=1, baz=2) for treescope display
render_dictionary_wrapper: render an object in wrapped dictionary format like Foo({"bar": 1}) for treescope display
render_enumlike_item: render a value of an enum-like type with name and value annotation for treescope display
build_treescope_repr: build a __treescope_repr__ method using render_object_constructor for custom type integration
register_custom_handler: register a custom treescope handler for third-party mapping or sequence types
